document.abstract: The purpose of this paper is to describe the codecs used to convert parallel components into SMAC, and SMAC back into parallel components.

authors.bio: Mr. Lowe, Chairman of the Board and Director of Advanced Development at Fortel, Inc., is actively involved in SMPTE as a manager in the Atlanta Chapter and in the Analog Components Working Group. Mr. Lowe started his career in broadcast television equipment in 1965 as a Quality-Control Engineer with Ampex on the VR-2000. He later founded Edutron, Inc., which became Fortel in 1982. Mr. Lowe enjoys product conceptualization and design. For the past ten years, he has designed time-base correctors and other products that utilize analog or digital components internally. Most of his recent designs have been digital memory and memory control systems, as shown in the paper on SMAC Codecs.
